The party/supplier shall visit the site once the order is placed to verify the site con ditions, dimensions , installation and user requirements before commencing the w ork. 2. Any slight adjustment in dimensions of the items should be carried out free of cost . 3. Any furniture or storage units that are damaged, defective, improperly aligned, or not conforming to the approved specifications/drawings shall be rejected and repl aced by the supplier at no additional cost. 4. All furniture and storage shelves shall be supplied as per the specifications, dimen sions and materials mentioned in the indent. 5. The supplier shall be responsible for transportation, unloading, assembly, installat ion, leveling, and fixing of all furniture and storage units at the designated site. 6. All materials, hardware, fittings, accessories, and fasteners used shall be of good quality and suitable for laboratory use. 7. The furniture shall have a neat and professional finish, with all edges properly fini

shed and free from sharp edges, cracks, dents, scratches, or other manufacturing defects. 8. The supplier shall ensure proper alignment, stability, leveling, and structural integ rity of the furniture and storage shelves after installation. 9. Any deviation from the specified dimensions, materials, design, or construction sh all be made only with the prior approval of the user department. 10. The supplier shall rectify or replace any defects observed during inspection or with in the warranty period at no additional cost to the purchaser. 11. A minimum warranty of 1 year shall be provided against manufacturing defects, m aterial defects, and workmanship defects from the date of installation/acceptance. 12. The supplier shall remove all packing materials, debris, and waste generated durin g installation and hand over the site in a clean condition. 13. Delivery and installation shall be completed within the stipulated period mentione d in the purchase order. 14. Payment shall be made only after satisfactory delivery, installation, inspection, an d acceptance of the furniture by the authorized representative. . 4.
